title: Samosa Chat
howToPrepare:
Ingredients

    4 large Punjabi samosas

    2 cups Chana Masala / Chole (warm)

    ½ cup plain yogurt, whisked with a pinch of salt and sugar

    ¼ cup mint-coriander green chutney

    ¼ cup sweet tamarind chutney

    ½ cup red onion, finely chopped

    ½ cup thin sev¼ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped1 tsp chaat masala

    ½ tsp roasted cumin powder

    ½ tsp Kashmiri red chili powder

    Instructions

    Heat the Samosas: Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 8 to 10 minutes or air-fry at 330°F (165°C) for 5 to 7 minutes until hot and crispy.Smash the Base: Place the warm samosas onto a plate and lightly smash them into bite-sized chunks with a fork.Layer the Chole: Ladle hot chana masala directly over the broken samosas.Add Sauces: Drizzle the whisked yogurt, green chutney, and tamarind chutney over the top.Season: Sprinkle evenly with chaat masala, roasted cumin powder, and red chili powder.Garnish: Top with chopped red onions, thin sev, and fresh cilantro. Serve immediately.
